text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
There's something serious I want to talk
to you
about.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure you've noticed that my
performance has
been slipping lately. I
just can't seem to put my
heart into it.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I know you have a plan to get me back
on track,
but I won't be able to win over
the world if I just
keep forcing myself to
keep going.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
So I'd like to ask for some time to
regroup. I'll
need it for the sake of
making our dreams a
reality, so I hope
you understand.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl walks off briskly. I'll
need to
rethink her upcoming race
schedule.
